description: Inspect selected views of completed binary-layout, JavaScript application, native analyze_function, inspect_artifact, inventory_artifact, inspect_wasm_artifact, inspect_macho, decode_interface_builder, inspect_evm_interface, inspect_managed_artifact, inspect_managed_members, inspect_android_package, inspect_dart_aot or inspect_web_network_capture Evidence without repeating analysis. Historical capture summaries return identity and counts without bodies or archive inventories. Capture views page retained records: view {kind: "capture", detail: "preview" | "complete", offset: 0, limit: 20}; preview selects recorded headline fields and binary descriptors, complete returns exact records with all sidecars. Offsets follow the selected parent record order, preserving original producer ordinals. Paging never reopens the source or reruns the decoder. For inspect_pcap_capture parents, kind pcap pages endpoints, dns-queries, tls-sni, protocols, http-uris or unattributed-addresses. Select an exact query for dns-addresses, or a tshark/capinfos stream for UTF-16 diagnostics text. Page totals count retained facts; source coverage remains explicit. Qlog summaries keep profile/scope and counts; kind qlog pages traces, streams, loss-declarations, incomplete-records, contributions, ranges or final-sizes. Except traces, select trace_index; stream-specific facets also require exact stream_id and direction. Facts retain all-recorded-events-before-selection scope, and interval overlap or endpoint loss declarations do not prove retransmission or network loss. The api-surface view groups retained HAR requests by method, origin and format-rule path template; templated segments are inferences. It reads no headers or bodies and reports no query values. For a retained record use source: {kind: "retained-evidence", evidence_id: "<parent_evidence_id>"}. Use normalized_result.parent_evidence_id from a summary receipt. Source kind is required. Portable source uses {kind: "inline", evidence: <complete Evidence>}. For layout, JavaScript, inventory, WASM, Mach-O, Interface Builder, EVM, managed artifact, Android package and Dart AOT sources, request a summary with view: {kind: "summary"}; summary is a view kind and has no facet. The WASM summary gives validation, counts, WAT digest/length, tool profile and execution/network states without reading WAT text. Select a layout mitigations/linkage facet, one section/symbol/module, or a stable page. Module pages include assets, bundled and source modules; use node_id for ambiguous or unavailable paths. Typed module references use view {kind: "javascript", collection: "modules", projection: "references", where: {path: "main.js", kind: "javascript-module"}, offset: 0, limit: 64}; where matches exact retained strings (null selects unavailable paths). Rows include canonical identity, retained source-range count and observation support states. Source coverage and selection remain explicit; exhausting matching rows does not prove runtime loading or complete analysis. For exact file/native facts and processing gaps, use view {kind: "javascript-facts", where: {paths: ["package.json"]}, property_keys: ["name", "operation", "analysis_status"]}. Rows page original observations with canonical identities and Evidence; missing properties remain omitted. Paths match recorded artifact-path/source-range locations; optional kinds filter nodes. To discover field names without values, opt into include_available_property_keys: true with property_keys: []. Canonical identity and Evidence are separate from properties; keep each node_id/observation_id pair together when composing results. Inventory uses view: {kind: "inventory", collection: "occurrences", logical_paths: ["package.json"], offset: 0, limit: 64}. Inventory views page nodes, occurrences, edges or integrity contradictions; occurrence logical_paths matches exact recorded strings (omitted means all available, [] means none). source_complete distinguishes complete inventories from partial source records; page exhaustion does not prove absence in a partial source. WASM views use kind wasm and facet sections/imports/exports/candidates/glue/wat/headers/details/tool_profile; text facets use UTF-16 code units and source forms remain exact. Mach-O views use kind macho and facet entrypoints/architectures/build_metadata/load_commands/dependencies/imports/exports/segments/provenance; source_exhaustive false means unreturned rows may exist. Interface Builder views use kind interface-builder and collection documents/nodes/edges/coverage; nodes and edges accept an exact document relative_path. EVM summary returns all inferred interface candidates, carrier/decoded identities and explicit unknowns without hex or duplicate stdout. EVM views use kind evm and facet functions/bytecode_hex/stdout/stderr; function pages preserve the original candidate rows, and text offsets/limits count UTF-16 code units (hex has two characters per decoded byte). Exhausting candidate pages does not establish global interface completeness. Managed artifact summaries preserve complete identity/classification, metadata status, module/MVID, frameworks, coverage and limitations without unrelated inventories. Managed pages use kind managed and collection references/resources/attributes, retaining source coverage and build-local token scope; page exhaustion does not establish complete metadata. Managed member summaries keep identity, selection with unmatched names, coverage and per-collection counts; managed-members pages use collection types/exported_types/fields/methods/member_refs/call_edges/field_accesses/user_strings and carry the source selection and coverage. Android package summaries retain all declarations, engine identity and counts without decoded manifest text. Android manifest pages use kind android, facet manifest, offset and limit in UTF-16 code units; source_status preserves partial decoded coverage even when the retained text page is exhausted. Dart AOT summary preserves target/ABI/library identity, snapshot headers and pool lower bounds. String pages use kind dart-aot, collection package_uris/dart_uris/class_like_tokens; source coverage remains partial when the producer says partial. Native function Evidence requires kind native: view: {kind: "native", facet: "procedure"}. Facets select procedure, pseudocode, assembly, basic blocks, comments, callers/callees, references, unresolved calls, referenced strings/names, native API and high-pcode. Use nonnegative offset and a positive caller-selected limit (defaults 0 and 64); pseudocode uses UTF-16 code units, other native pages use rows. Returns artifact identity, parent Evidence ID, a distinct view digest, coverage, limitations and unknowns. Actual serialized size determines MCP transport admission; choose a smaller page or export the complete retained Evidence if needed.

il_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exactly the raw il_size CIL bytes; excludes the method header, locals signature, alignment, and extra sections

normalized_il_sha256.description: Member-result-v1 SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON [opcode, operand_kind, operand] tuples for a complete decode; retains build-local tokens, omits switch targets, and excludes headers, locals, and exception regions

field_declaring_type.description: Declaring type of the accessed field; null when unknown

value.description: Decoded UTF-16 code units, excluding the terminal flag byte; unpaired surrogates are kept

logical_paths.description: Exact recorded logical paths. Omitted selects all available occurrences; an empty array selects none. This does not resolve filesystem paths.

resolved_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw signature with each TypeDef or TypeRef operand replaced by that type's namespace-qualified name; equals raw_sha256 when the signature names no types. Unlike raw_sha256 it does not depend on build-local metadata rows. Null when the signature could not be decoded or names a type REA could not resolve, such as a TypeSpec.

path.description: Exact recorded artifact path, including an empty string.

requested_paths.description: Exact relevant file paths from the artifact inventory, relative to the application root, analyzed in first-request order before unselected scopes; no globs or implicit dependencies. Omit to analyze all sources.

__schema60.description: Signature type-name resolution was examined, including unresolved operands; null means historical Evidence without this attestation.

__schema62.description: Whether all NestedClass rows were read and valid. Null for historical Evidence; false means current nesting is incomplete. Individual name digests can remain unresolved for missing, cyclic or over-deep enclosing chains.
